Build passes.

## Summary

Investigated the nav structure first: `frontend/src/components/layout/Navbar.jsx` is dead code (not imported anywhere; App.tsx renders `SiteHeader`/`SiteFooter` instead), and no other component lists the full set of top-level flows. The single live discovery surface for all module flows is `HomeHub.tsx`'s `MODULE_TILES` array, which doubles as both the tile grid and the app's de facto nav.

**Change:** `frontend/src/pages/HomeHub.tsx:44` — added a tile entry:
```js
{ title: "Attorney Referral", subtitle: "Connect with a Florida attorney", to: "/attorney-referral", icon: "👩‍⚖️" },
```
Follows the exact existing tile pattern (title/subtitle/route/icon, rendered via `<HubTile>`). Title matches the page's own `<h1>` heading, "Attorney Referral" (`AttorneyReferralFL.tsx:97`) — there was no "Talk to an Attorney" wording anywhere in the codebase to match against.

No second nav change was made since there's no other live nav component listing top-level flows to add an entry to.

**Build:** `npm run build` passes (had to run `npm install` first — vite wasn't installed).
